# AltStack Desktop changelog feed (specification)

The release process publishes a machine-readable changelog at

    https://altstack.io/apt/changelog.json

next to the signed repository (it is part of the `apt/` tree and is covered by the same deployment). Amerika Software,
the welcome window and the Settings "About" page read it to show "What's new" without contacting any other service.

* Generated by `flavor/tools/make_changelog_feed.py` from `flavor/debian-src/debian/changelog`; never edited by hand.
* Served as `application/json`, UTF-8, at most 256 KiB (older releases are dropped, newest first).
* **Integrity**: the release job also publishes a detached signature `changelog.json.asc` (made with the archive signing key, see
  `docs/KEY-ROTATION.md`). Clients verify it against the pinned keyring or treat the feed as unauthenticated display text.
  The feed must never trigger actions.
* Clients treat all strings as untrusted plain text (no HTML, no Markdown rendering of links).
* Clients cache for 6 hours and send no identifying headers.

## Document

`changelog-feed.schema.json` is the JSON Schema. Summary:

| field | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `schema` | integer | always `1` |
| `source` | string | Debian source package, `amerika-os` |
| `generated` | RFC 3339 string | build time (UTC) |
| `channel` | string | `stable` or `testing` |
| `releases[]` | array, newest first | one entry per changelog stanza |
| `releases[].version` | string | Debian version, e.g. `3.0.8` |
| `releases[].date` | RFC 3339 string | taken from the changelog trailer line |
| `releases[].urgency` | string | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical` |
| `releases[].security` | boolean | true when the entry mentions a CVE or "security" |
| `releases[].changes[]` | strings | one line per bullet, bullets merged into plain lines |

Example:

```json
{"schema": 1, "source": "amerika-os", "generated": "2026-10-21T12:00:00Z", "channel": "stable",
 "releases": [{"version": "3.0.8", "date": "2026-10-21T10:00:00Z", "urgency": "medium", "security": false,
               "changes": ["Add flavour packages and installer configuration."]}]}
```
